crew.overview: The origin story of former Special Forces operative turned mercenary Wade Wilson, who, after being subjected to a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing powers, adopts the alter ego Deadpool. Armed with his new abilities and a dark, twisted sense of humor, Deadpool hunts down the man who nearly destroyed his life.
crew.title: Deadpool

crew.overview: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.
crew.title: Deadpool & Wolverine

details.biography:
Geoff Redknap’s make-up effects artistry spans The X-Files to Deadpool. He attended the NSI’s Drama Prize Programme, where he wrote and directed the award-winning short film The Auburn Hills Breakdown and the NSI’s Features First with Hangfire, a top-1% finalist in the Austin Film Festival Screenplay Competition. Geoff has written and directed nine short films, including The Unseen, a feature that premiered at Fantasia, played at 28 festivals, and won awards.

Geoff is with Zero Gravity Management.
details.name: Geoff Redknap
